material_difference: Old Plane468 was screened without a saved design or API call. New design explicitly matches existing white contact-edge orientation units to every exposed contact, targeting incidence count rather than distinct neighboring tiles. No new tile or hidden black-black edge is drawn.
predeclared_geometric_error_rule: Count every one of the 30 exposed unit edges as a distinct new white tile. Then 6+30-13=23, double-counting the twelve two-contact receivers.
